messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for service `model-serving-prod` (5xx > 8% over 5m). Pager sent to @eng-oncall primary and secondary. Incident ID INC-2026-0473

maya: I'm on it, grabbing context. Root cause guess: tail latency spikes after the 18:00 deploy? Can someone confirm deploy history?

raj: I didn't see a deploy at 18:00 in the pipeline. Last deploy was 16:42 to canary, 17:10 to prod (small model bump). I can join for mitigation.

sarah: Paging as secondary. Quick checks: GPU utilization, queue length, and k8s restarts.

kevin: Looking at metrics: redis cache miss rate jumped at 17:58 and request queue length doubled. Latency heatmap shows more 99th percentile across a subset of hosts (us-west-2-a).

emily: I'm checking routing: smart-router sent ~12% traffic to v2-quantized variant; fallback rules should handle it but maybe v2 has a regression.

maya: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.runbooks/internal/oncall/model-serving#high-error-rate. Steps I'm taking: 1) mark incident as acknowledged, 2) fail traffic to stable model variant, 3) open mitigation PR if needed.

maya: Acknowledged INC-2026-0473. @opsbot mark acknowledged by maya

opsbot: Incident INC-2026-0473 status updated: acknowledged by maya at 2026-03-14T18:06:39Z

raj: Quick mitigation: switching routing policy to prefer `v1-stable` for requests > 512 tokens. Command: `curl -X POST https://router.api/reroute -d '{"policy":"prefer:v1-stable","ttl":300}'`

kevin: Doing a targeted drain of the faulty hosts in us-west-2-a while router changes propagate. `kubectl cordon node/usw2-a-node-17` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets node/usw2-a-node-17`

sarah: Noting customer impact: internal SLO alerting shows a spike in failed responses for `customer:acme-inc` and `customer:free-tier`. Could be broader but initial blast radius limited to us-west-2.

emily: After reroute to v1-stable, error rate dropped to ~0.9% within 90s. Latency 99p also stabilized.

maya: Good. I've promoted the emergency rollback for the model variant to hotfix channel and started a rollback job: `deployctl rollback model-serving v2-quantized --reason "5xx spike"`

raj: Filed ticket RDW-3421 for investigation: "v2-quantized regression causing cache miss / 5xx spike". Assigning to eng-ml triage.

maya: Handoff: my shift ends in 30m. I'll pass primary to @raj and secondary to @sarah. Current state: mitigation active, traffic routed to v1-stable, rollback job in progress (40% complete), affected hosts cordoned. No customer-facing outage post-mitigation but partial degradations recorded.

raj: Taking primary. I'll monitor rollback, verify canary, and coordinate with eng-ml for root cause.

sarah: Secondary ack. I'll keep watch on errors and liaise with support for any incoming tickets.

maya: Coverage gap note: nights (00:00-06:00 UTC) lack dedicated ML-engineering secondary; we'll need on-call rotation adjustment. I'll file action item.

emily: Logged the support cases: S-9812 (acme-inc) and S-9813 (free-tier). Both have been updated with "mitigation in place, monitoring".

opsbot: Incident INC-2026-0473 status updated: mitigated at 2026-03-14T18:22:12Z (mitigation: traffic reroute + rollback initiated)

maya: Post-handoff follow-ups before I go: 1) RDW-3421 (investigation) assigned to eng-ml; 2) RDW-3422 created for runbook update around model variant routing and TTLs; 3) schedule a retro — suggested time: 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. Link: https://calendar.redwood/meet/retro-INC-2026-0473

raj: I'll be the owner for RDW-3421. I'll also add logs and KV cache stats to the ticket.

sarah: I'll own RDW-3422 runbook edits — will add explicit preflight checks and a checklist for rolling back model variants.

kevin: Action item: add an alert for cache-miss-rate > 4% that's tied to routing automation to prevent this class of regression from routing too much traffic. I'll open RDW-3423.

emily: Noting that customer comms follow-up needed: support to send a short summary to impacted customers once postmortem available.

maya: Thanks team, handing off now. If anything spikes, page raj first. Going offline for handoff. :wave:

raj: Acknowledged, thanks maya. Monitoring now.

sarah: Acknowledged. Will update if anything changes.

kevin: Follow-ups created: RDW-3423 (alert tuning).

emily: Retro invite sent to eng-oncall, eng-ml, and support.

opsbot: Incident INC-2026-0473 last updated: status=monitoring, owner=raj, severity=SEV3

raj: last note before shift check: backup plan if rollback fails — enable auto-fallback to smaller model shard and enable token-throttling policy `tt-policy:conservative`. Runbook snippet:```
# fallback sequence
1) set router policy prefer:v1-stable
2) enable token-throttling policy tt-policy:conservative
3) scale up v1-stable pool by +20%
```

sarah: copying that into RDW-3421. Okay team, I'll stay on until 19:30 UTC to make sure no regressions.

maya: thanks all, signing off. :coffee:
